SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, invalid_reason
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) LIKE '%proton pump inhibitor%'
   OR lower(concept_name) IN ('omeprazole','pantoprazole','lansoprazole','esomeprazole','rabeprazole','dexlansoprazole','ilaprazole')
ORDER BY domain_id, concept_class_id, concept_name
LIMIT 100;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ppi_ingredients AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_id IN (19039926,904453,929887,923645,948078,43009052,911735)
), ppi_desc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN ppi_ingredients i ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.concept_id
), first_ppi AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ppi_desc p ON de.drug_concept_id = p.concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
), new_ppi AS (
  SELECT fp.person_id, fp.index_date
  FROM first_ppi fp
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de2
    JOIN ppi_desc p2 ON de2.drug_concept_id = p2.concept_id
    WHERE de2.person_id = fp.person_id
      AND de2.drug_exposure_start_date < fp.index_date
  )
), mg_labs AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.measurement_date, m.value_as_number, m.unit_concept_id, u.concept_name AS unit_name
  FROM omop.measurement m
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept u ON u.concept_id = m.unit_concept_id
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3001420,3006916)
    AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT TOP 20 unit_concept_id, unit_name, COUNT(*) AS n,
       MIN(value_as_number) AS min_value, MAX(value_as_number) AS max_value,
       AVG(value_as_number) AS avg_value
FROM mg_labs
GROUP BY unit_concept_id, unit_name
ORDER BY n DESC;

WITH ppi_ingredients AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_id IN (19039926,904453,929887,923645,948078,43009052,911735)
), ppi_desc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN ppi_ingredients i ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.concept_id
), candidate_index AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ppi_desc p ON de.drug_concept_id = p.concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
), new_ppi AS (
  SELECT ci.person_id, ci.index_date
  FROM candidate_index ci
  JOIN omop.observation_period op
    ON op.person_id = ci.person_id
   AND DATEADD(day, -365, ci.index_date) >= op.observation_period_start_date
   AND DATEADD(day, 90, ci.index_date) <= op.observation_period_end_date
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de0
    JOIN ppi_desc p0 ON de0.drug_concept_id = p0.concept_id
    WHERE de0.person_id = ci.person_id
      AND de0.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(day, -365, ci.index_date)
      AND de0.drug_exposure_start_date < ci.index_date
  )
), mg_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.person_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number < 1.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_low_mg,
         COUNT(*) AS mg_measurements
  FROM new_ppi n
  JOIN omop.measurement m
    ON m.person_id = n.person_id
   AND m.measurement_date >= n.index_date
   AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, n.index_date)
   AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3001420,3006916) -- Magnesium mass/volume in serum/plasma or blood
   AND m.unit_concept_id = 8840 -- mg/dL
   AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY n.person_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS new_ppi_users,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mg.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS users_with_mg_recorded_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mg.has_low_mg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS users_with_mg_lt_1_6_90d,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mg.has_low_mg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS pct_of_new_ppi_users,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mg.has_low_mg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN mg.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS pct_among_users_with_mg_recorded
FROM new_ppi n
LEFT JOIN mg_90 mg ON mg.person_id = n.person_id;

content.text:
Using OMOP drug exposures for first observed PPI use and magnesium measurements in `mg/dL` within 90 days:

- New PPI users: `144,937`
- Had magnesium recorded within 90 days: `41,516` (`28.64%`)
- Had magnesium `< 1.6 mg/dL` within 90 days: `9,858`

So, magnesium `< 1.6 mg/dL` was recorded in:

- `6.80%` of all new PPI users
- `23.75%` of new PPI users who had magnesium measured within 90 days

Cohort definition used: first observed exposure to RxNorm PPI ingredients/descendants, with 365-day prior and 90-day follow-up observation-period coverage.
